description:
About Fospha

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The role

We're hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You'll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients.

This is a role for a doer. You'll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it's worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle.

You'll join an established team, supporting our continued transformation in a post-AI era. We're looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management.

What you'll do

  • Own a product area end to end. Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. Make the sequencing calls for your area and run several initiatives in parallel.
  • Start every initiative with why. Before anything is built, be clear on the client problem, the evidence for it, the expected impact for clients, what it's worth commercially, how it fits our pricing and packaging, and how it advances company strategy. Fospha's business strategy hinges on its product strategy, so every initiative should trace back to it. Say no to good ideas that aren't the most important thing.
  • Stay close to clients. Don't wait to be invited: set up your own client calls as well as joining others', run interviews and prototype sessions, and pair what clients tell you with what the usage data shows. Know what clients see on screen and what they do with it.
  • Decide quickly on imperfect information. Know when the evidence is strong enough to act, make the call, and change course when the evidence changes, including stopping work that isn't landing.
  • Work AI-first. Use AI to compress discovery synthesis, analysis, spec writing and stakeholder communication. Build and refine your own agents, workflows and prototypes, and work with engineers on what can be prototyped with AI coding tools. Share what works with other PMs and feed improvements back to Product Ops, so the whole team gets faster.
  • Prove it worked. Set success thresholds before build starts, check adoption and usage after release, and act on the result. Shipped is not the same as worked.
  • Give people what they need to decide. Know what information a decision-maker needs at each point, and give them exactly that: a one-line recommendation for an exec, the full detail for an engineer. Present with confidence to senior leaders, internally and at clients.
  • Raise the bar. Give direct, useful feedback, take it well, and hold your own work to a high standard.

What you'll bring (must-haves)

  1. 3+ years as a Product Manager, or in an adjacent role with experience you can clearly apply to product management. Either way, you can point to problems you owned end to end: deciding what to do, getting it delivered, and measuring whether it worked against success criteria set upfront.
  2. 2+ years making decisions from data yourself - product analytics (funnels, usage, retention) and commercial data - pulling and checking your own numbers rather than waiting for an analyst.
  3. A track record of connecting your work to commercial outcomes. You've sized opportunities in revenue or retention terms, built business cases, and shaped pricing, packaging or monetisation decisions with commercial teams.
  4. Hands-on client experience. You've run customer discovery, joined sales and account calls, and turned what clients experience into a clear, evidenced problem statement.
  5. Confidence in presenting to peers and senior stakeholders. You're confident making and presenting recommendations to leaders across the business, advocating for data-backed decisions.
  6. Deep, everyday use of AI in your work. You can describe specific workflows, agents or tools you've built or configured, the work they replaced, and how you check their output.

How you work

  • Conscientious. You close loops, follow through on what you said you'd do, and catch data or quality issues before they reach a client.
  • Relentless about prioritisation. You can explain why this, why now and what it's worth, and you're comfortable leaving lower-value work undone.
  • Decisive. You'd rather make a well-reasoned call today than a perfect one next month, and you're open about the assumptions behind it.
  • Analytical. You break a problem down, work out what would need to be true, and go and find the data to test it.
  • Clear and concise. You write and present crisply, lead with the recommendation, and cut what the audience doesn't need.
  • Open on feedback. You give it directly and kindly, ask for it, and act on it.
  • A doer. You'd rather build a prototype and a short one-pager than write an extensive PRD about one.

Nice to have

  • Product experience within a complicated B2B data platform business.
  • Product experience within marketing or advertising technology.

Benefits (UK)

  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal - Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year
  • Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
  • Opportunities to travel - including to our India and North America offices

description:
About Scale

Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.

The Role

The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI. The government's AI Opportunities Action Plan set out to "mainline AI into the veins" of the country, and the focus has now moved to delivery: the Incubator for AI (i.AI) is shipping tools like the Humphrey suite into departments, a Sovereign AI Unit and AI Growth Zones are being stood up, and civilian departments are under real pressure to move from pilots to production. Scale can play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications that shift depends on.

We're looking for someone to lead that work in central government. This isn’t about staying in the office and managing a team of sales people, its about building the business from the front. You'd own our commercial relationships across civilian departments, starting where the near-term pipeline is strongest: HMRC, DWP, and NHS.

This is a critical role reporting directly to our Head of Public Sector, UK. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into these departments before and knows how they actually make decisions, not just how the org charts look.

What you'll do

  • Own our commercial plan and pipeline for UK civilian central government
  • Find, shape, and close deals yourself, from the first conversation through to contract and into delivery
  • Use the relationships you already have across departments like HMRC, DWP, and NHS
  • Work the frameworks, tenders and teaming, and know which route to market is worth the effort and which isn't.
  • Be a credible counterpart to senior civil servants, and turn what they need into work we can deliver
  • Stay close to our product and delivery teams so what we sell is what we build
  • Hire and lead a small team over time, and help shape the wider UK public sector plan with the UK Public Sector Lead

What we're looking for

  • You've sold and delivered technology or transformation work to UK civilian central government, either from a vendor or from inside government
  • You’ve rolled up your sleeves and built something from scratch, whether that’s a new vertical, territory or product launch
  • You know at least one major department well (e.g. HMRC, DWP, or NHS) and how it buys
  • You understand public sector procurement: frameworks, tenders, and buying that runs through a lot of stakeholders
  • You've opened doors, run complex pursuits, and owned the result
  • You have relationships with senior people across departments
  • You do your best work when things are ambiguous and moving quickly

People who tend to fit this have spent years leading UK public sector work at companies like Palantir, Google, AWS, Microsoft or Oracle, at consultancies and systems integrators like Accenture, Deloitte, EY, Bain or McKinsey, or in senior commercial or programme roles inside the departments themselves.

Why join

You'd be building this market, not maintaining it. There's no playbook to inherit, which is rather the point. The deals you win, and the way you win them, will shape how Scale works with UK government for years.

About Us

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., Middle Eastern governments, and U.S. government agencies. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace.

description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. Driving product initiatives with founders and engineers. Help frame the problem, facilitate decisions and turn a direction into projects and tasks the team can execute. Making the product coherent as it grows. Own interaction and visual quality, including the design system, without slowing down experimentation. WHAT WE CARE ABOUT You have shipped complex software products for expert users and can point to the decisions you made, not just the final screens. You are comfortable when the problem is not yet defined. You form your own opinion, push back and help create clarity. You have strong product judgment. description:
As a Senior Product Owner, you will manage the execution of NMI's strategy and roadmap, while facilitating backlog grooming, prioritisation, triage and other development ceremonies. Our Product Owners also take an active role in product launches, ensuring internal stakeholders are trained on the latest product capabilities.

You will need a unique blend of business and technical savvy, a big-picture vision and attention to detail, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time learning the product and understanding its users in order to make the best design decisions for our clients.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

What will I be doing?

  • Prioritise the product backlog and coordinate with stakeholders including the Product Manager, customer facing teams, executives and your development team to deliver maximum value and quality to the market.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in the relevant product domains.

description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

The role

This is a hybrid role: a designer who builds, or an engineer who designs. You have the eye to know what good looks like and the code to make it repeatable. You build and run the automated workstreams that Fanatics Casino, and the teams around it, produce brand-safe creative from every day: template and variant generators, image and video generation with our rules built in, copy-to-layout pipelines, Figma plugins.

The stack is already here: a shared Figma design system, Figma Motion and Figma Buzz for locked self-serve templates, Figma Weave for generative image and video, Creative Engine for automated static and video assets, and Runway. You turn them into automated templates and workflows that CRM, performance marketing and partners run themselves, with brand, responsible gaming and compliance rules built in so the output is right by default; you own best-in-class video generation, and train the models that keep generated imagery and video looking like us. The tools you make are run by CRM managers, performance marketers and designers across in-app, CRM and paid. You can build, not just brief. Design judgement decides what gets built.

What you’ll do

  • Build and execute automated workstreams for teams including CRM, performance marketing, partners and design: template and variant generators, copy-to-layout pipelines, Figma plugins and automation scripts that go from brief to approved asset, connecting the existing stack end to end (design system components into Buzz templates, Weave agent workflows for promo imagery, Creative Engine extended from Markets into CRM and in-app).
  • Own best-in-class video generation: set up and run the generative video pipeline across Weave, Runway and Creative Engine for hooks, variants, start frames and localisations, and decide which tool does what where they overlap.
  • Train and maintain LoRAs and custom models on the Casino visual identity, products, characters and partner assets so generated imagery and video stay on-brand without hand-fixing; retrain when the brand or a partner changes.
  • Encode the Casino visual identity, responsible gaming requirements and market-specific compliance rules into every workstream, so a CRM manager or performance marketer can run it and the output is safe by default: disclaimer and RG messaging legible and correctly placed at every size. Creative approves anything new.
  • Target the highest-volume executions first (CRM banners, in-app promo cards, paid variants) and measure the before and after in hours per asset.
  • Own the tools after launch: fix them when the brand, a regulator or a vendor model changes, and retire what stops working.
  • Work with the Lead Motion & 3D Designer on motion templates and render pipelines, and with the Design Lead on how brand rules translate into constraints.
  • Document what you build so the team can use it without you, and train the people who run it.
  • Present the roadmap and results to Design, Marketing and senior leadership in plain terms.

What you bring

  • Hands-on generative AI in production: image and video generation pipelines across tools like Weave, Runway and ComfyUI, LoRA or fine-tune training for brand consistency, prompt and workflow design. Used through their APIs, not only their interfaces.
  • Judgement about AI output: you can evaluate models on quality, cost, licensing and brand risk, set guardrails, handle failure modes, and tell a marketer plainly what a model can and cannot do.
  • 5+ years across design and engineering in any mix, with at least 2 building tools other people used in production. You have shipped design work and you have shipped code; we will ask to see both.
  • Working code: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, Figma plugin development or equivalent, and a track record of shipping something maintainable rather than a prototype.
  • Enough design craft to tell good from bad and to turn a brand guideline into a rule a machine can apply: layout, typography, colour, hierarchy.
  • A portfolio or repo of tools you built, with who used them, what they replaced and what changed as a result.
  • Comfort in a regulated category where some outputs must never ship, and the instinct to design for that.
  • Clear communication with non-technical colleagues, and the patience to train the people who will run what you build.
  • Curiosity about where the tools are going, and a point of view on what we should not automate.

Bonus points

  • iGaming, sportsbook or another regulated consumer category.
  • Dynamic creative or creative automation platforms (Celtra, Storyteq, Bannerflow, Creatopy) and a view on where they fall short.
  • Motion and 3D pipeline work: After Effects scripting, Cinema 4D or Blender automation, render or FFmpeg tooling.
  • Internal tools with a lightweight front end (React, Streamlit or similar) that non-engineers adopted.
  • Working alongside CRM, lifecycle or performance marketing teams on high-volume, multi-market output.

Your first 90 days

You'll learn the stack, the brand rules and the three executions where volume hurts most. You'll ship the first automated workstream against one of them, with CRM running it, and show the hours it saved. You'll have a brand LoRA in use and a clear answer to which of Weave and Runway does what.

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

Why be a Senior Digital Activation Executive at LOOKFANTASTIC? 

The Senior Digital Activation Executive role sits within THG Beauty's Retail Media structure, working closely with brand marketing leads, buying, trading, performance marketing and creative teams to deliver impactful, brand-funded media campaigns.

This is a hands-on digital activation role, combining platform expertise, campaign execution and performance analysis with brand-facing relationship management. You'll play a key role in bringing media plans to life across platforms such as Meta and TikTok, monitoring performance, making data-led optimisations and reporting on campaign success.

You'll act as an external-facing LOOKFANTASTIC ambassador and media specialist, building relationships with our brand partners and helping them maximise their investment through effective digital activation.

As a Senior Digital Activation Executive, you'll:

  • Build strong relationships with LOOKFANTASTIC's key brand partners, understanding their objectives and developing data-driven paid media strategies to drive brand growth.
  • Develop, pitch and activate multi-platform digital media plans across relevant paid social and digital advertising channels.
  • Take hands-on ownership of campaign activation across platforms, including Meta Business Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, managing campaign set-up, implementation and ongoing performance.
  • Monitor live campaign performance, proactively identifying opportunities to optimise targeting, creative, budgets and delivery against agreed KPIs and ROI targets.
  • Own mid-campaign and post-campaign reporting, analysing performance data, identifying key insights and demonstrating campaign uplift and return on investment.
  • Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for brand partners, helping shape future media strategies and secure incremental investment.
  • Work collaboratively with our influencer team to commission high-quality influencer assets for paid media repurposing.
  • Support social-first creative and ad copy development, briefing our in-house creative team to deliver engaging, high-performing assets.
  • Work closely with wider marketing, e-commerce, buying and trading teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with wider commercial objectives.
  • Keep up to date with emerging digital platforms, advertising features and industry trends, bringing new ideas and opportunities to improve campaign performance.

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

  • 2+ years' experience in paid media, digital marketing or digital campaign activation.
  • Hands-on experience with paid media platforms, ideally Meta Business Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, with confidence setting up, managing and optimising campaigns.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data, monitor KPIs and produce meaningful performance reports.
  • A commercial mindset, understanding how to use media investment effectively to drive performance, growth and ROI.
  • Confidence working with campaign budgets, targeting, creative testing and optimisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently present campaign recommendations to external brand partners.
  • A proactive, digitally savvy individual who naturally keeps up with emerging platforms, social trends and developments in the paid media landscape.
  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

The Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity 
  • Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management
  • Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall operations
  • Approve return to saleable stock
  • Ensure that customers are entitled to receive the products prior to shipment
  • Ensure the WDA registration remains current with the commercial supply chain setup
  • Ensure the accuracy of quality records and that GDP requirements are implemented and maintained in the quality management system, as required for the WDA license
  • Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness 
  • Ensure data integrity and own the entity's internal audit (self-inspection) program
  • Own the GDP quality agreement matrix: contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces 
  • Review and write standard operating procedures in BridgeBio’s document management system in accordance with the GDP requirements
  • Ensure there is a training program for BridgeBio staff working under GDP and ensure that the relevant staff members are trained on GDP
  • Participate in GDP vendor qualification program
  • Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications
  • Perform distribution release for finished goods received from the contract manufacturing organization, which can include review of temperature, shipping and receiving documentation 
  • Be responsible for and be directly involved in product complaints from the EU and ROW markets
  • Provide GDP and QA related support and intelligence
  • Be available and reachable 24/7 

Other QA/Quality Person related responsibilities 

  • Build, lead and develop the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP, if needed
  • Implement and maintain the entity's GDP-compliant quality management system by adopting existing BridgeBio quality frameworks, adapted to the entity's license requirements
  • Work closely with the affiliate quality leads to resolve quality issues and keep the intercompany interfaces effective
  • Prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import, API GMP verification, and batch-certification processes), if needed 
  • Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents as needed 
  • Participate in regulatory inspections  
  • Participate in internal and external project team meetings 
  • Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary  
  • Other duties as assigned 

Where You’ll Work 

This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred 
  • Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred) 
  • Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)
  • Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products 
  • Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory management 
  • Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance 
  • Working in a highly regulated environment 
  • Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems 
  • BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy
  • Documented GDP training and the education and experience to be accepted as Responsible Person by the Dutch authorities (Farmatec/IGJ)

Skills

  • Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines 
  • Fluent in English language; written/spoken in Dutch language, preferred 
  • Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload 
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail 
  • Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP 
  • Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture  

 

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible

  • We have high expectations for our team members
  • We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return
  • Market leading compensationHybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community
  • We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles:

Financial & Rewards  

  • Market-leading compensation   
  • 401(k) with employer match   
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)  
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit and parking)  
  • Referral bonus for hired candidates  
  • Subsidized lunch and parking on in-office days  

Health & Well-Being  

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents  
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)  
  • Fertility & family-forming benefits  
  •  Expanded mental health support (therapy and coaching resources)  
  • Hybrid work model with flexibility  
  • Flexible, “take-what-you-need” paid time off and company-paid holidays  
  • Comprehensive paid medical and parental leave to care for yourself and your family  

Skill Development & Career Paths: 

  • People are part of our growth and success story - from discovery to active drug trials and FDA pipelines, there are endless opportunities for skill development and internal mobility 
  • We provide career pathing through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs via LinkedIn Learning, LifeLabs, & BetterUp Coaching 
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities 

By applying, you acknowledge that BridgeBio will process your personal information as described in our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

About the role: What's in the Box

We are seeking a highly strategic, operational, and empathetic Senior Director, Human Resources – Field Operations (Europe). In this critical leadership role, you will serve as the principal HR Business Partner to the SVP of Europe Operations while providing strategic direction and mentorship to a distributed team of Site HR professionals across our European fulfillment centers.

You will bridge the gap between high-level operational strategy and on-the-ground employee experience. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, complex logistics or manufacturing environment, deeply understands European labor dynamics, and possesses the executive presence to challenge, coach, and partner with senior supply chain leaders.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Strategic Business Partnering

  • Act as the dedicated HR Business Partner and trusted advisor to the SVP, Europe Operations, aligning human capital strategy with broader business and operational goals.
  • Drive organizational design, workforce planning, and change management initiatives across the European operations network to ensure scalable, efficient, and agile structures.
  • Coach and guide senior operational leadership on talent density, performance management, succession planning, and inclusive leadership.

Field HR Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Site HR Managers, Directors, and HRBPs embedded within our local fulfillment centers across multiple European countries (e.g., Germany, UK, Netherlands, France, Sweden, and Norway).
  • Foster a cohesive, collaborative HR community across the region, ensuring best-in-class HR service delivery, consistency in policy application, and a unified company culture.
  • Establish clear KPIs and metrics for the Field HR team, utilizing data to track retention, engagement, and operational efficiency.

Labor Relations, Works Council & Employee Experience

  • Architect a proactive employee relations strategy tailored to a blue-collar, high-volume operational workforce.
  • Navigate complex European labor laws, partnering with local HR and legal teams to manage relationships with representation wherever applicable. 
  • Spearhead engagement and retention initiatives for frontline workers, ensuring a safe, inclusive, and rewarding workplace environment in our fulfillment centers.

Operational HR Excellence

  • Partner with Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Shared Service) to build customized programs for Field Operations, including competitive hourly wage structures, peak-season hiring strategies, and frontline leadership training.
  • Standardize and optimize core HR processes across European sites while respecting local nuances and compliance requirements.
  • Champion HelloFresh’s data-driven culture by analyzing employee feedback, turnover data, and absenteeism trends to implement targeted interventions.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

  • Experience: 12+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, with a minimum of 5 years leading HR functions in high-volume, multi-site Supply Chain, Fulfillment, Manufacturing, or Logistics environments.
  • Executive Partnering: Proven track record of operating as a strategic HRBP to C-suite or SVP-level operations leaders, with the ability to influence without authority and drive systemic change.
  • Pan-European Expertise: Deep understanding of European labor laws, compliance standards, and significant experience negotiating and collaborating with Works Councils and trade unions.
  • Leadership: Exceptional team leadership skills with experience managing, scaling, and empowering remote/distributed HR teams.
  • Analytical Acumen: A heavily data-driven approach to HR. You rely on metrics and analytics to identify root causes, build business cases, and measure the success of people initiatives.
  • Agility & Resilience: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, and dynamic environment where ambiguity is common and speed is critical.
  • Languages: Business fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional European language (e.g., German, Dutch, French) is highly preferred.

What we offer: The Toppings

  • Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
  • Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
  • Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
  • Benefit from long-term wealth creation: Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.
  • Thrive in a high-performance environment: Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.

Senior Site Due Diligence Design Engineer

About the Team

The Senior Site Due Diligence Design Engineer plays a critical role in CoreWeave's data centre development pipeline by providing the first full technical evaluation of prospective sites. As the first engineering representative in site selection and due diligence, you will bring a broad, multidisciplinary perspective to judge how well each site can support CoreWeave's requirements across all major design disciplines.

You will be the technical bridge between the Site Selection team and the broader Design & Engineering organisation. From first site introduction through lease execution or acquisition, you will lead technical due diligence. That includes evaluating infrastructure capacity, utility availability, building suitability, land use and entitlements, and early design constraints, and working directly with data centre providers, utilities, landlords, and external partners. Once a site is secured, you will hand it off to the assigned Design Manager for full project design. The role calls for strong engineering judgment, the ability to interpret information across disciplines, and the confidence to represent CoreWeave's technical priorities in early strategic conversations.

This role requires frequent travel to prospective data centre locations across the EMEA and APAC regions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Initial Technical Evaluation: Act as the first technical evaluator for prospective data centre sites across electrical, mechanical, architectural, civil, and IT/LV disciplines, identifying technical risks, constraints, opportunities, and required upgrades.
  • Early-Phase Design Leadership: Lead the design team from initial site concept through lease execution or acquisition, coordinating all design activities in these early phases. Take part in early design and scoping discussions to align everyone on CoreWeave's requirements and technical expectations.
  • Proposal & Document Review: Review provider proposals, capacity offers, utility information, conceptual layouts, and as-built drawings to confirm they align with CoreWeave's design principles. Make sure technical requirements are correctly reflected in early documents such as LOIs, provider proposals, and preliminary agreements.
  • External Engagement: Work directly with landlords, developers, data centre providers, and utilities during early due diligence. Run early technical workshops with providers so they correctly understand CoreWeave's design expectations and project objectives.
  • Power & Utility Assessment: Review site infrastructure, including power availability, redundancy options, upstream utility constraints, delivery timelines, and required upgrades.
  • Mechanical Feasibility: Assess heat rejection options, water availability and quality, mechanical yard capacity, and compatibility with CoreWeave cooling strategies (e.g., chilled water plants, CDUs, TCS loops).
  • Building Suitability: Evaluate structural capacity, floor loading, egress paths, ceiling heights, roof strength, envelope condition, and potential for expansion.
  • Land Use & Entitlements: Evaluate land use, zoning, permitting, and entitlement feasibility at a high level, and identify regulatory constraints or municipal approval risks that could affect schedule, density, or constructability.
  • Conceptual MEP & Risk Assessment: Develop high-level conceptual MEP assessments. Identify and document site-specific blockers and risks, with clear impacts on scope, cost, schedule, density, constructability, and long-term scalability.
  • Assessments & Recommendations: Prepare concise technical due diligence summaries and early go/no-go recommendations covering feasibility findings, required upgrades, regulatory considerations, and alignment with CoreWeave's design and operational requirements.
  • Pipeline Tracking: Build and manage dashboards or similar tools to track technical progress, risks, land-use considerations, and milestones for all active candidate sites.
  • SME Collaboration: Work with internal SMEs and the broader design team. Resolve early-stage questions yourself where possible, and route discipline-specific topics quickly to the right experts.
  • Design Handover: Deliver a structured technical handover to the assigned Design Manager once a lease is executed or a site is acquired, so full project design continues seamlessly.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in data centre engineering, MEP consulting, site selection, due diligence, or early-phase design and development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Architectural Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Broad technical competency across electrical, mechanical, civil/structural, and architectural fundamentals, with the ability to evaluate multi-discipline issues without full SME support.
  • Strong understanding of utility infrastructure, such as power delivery, substations, feeders, water sources, and permitting, and how it affects site feasibility.
  • Experience reviewing capacity offers, conceptual site plans, utility data, and building documentation from data centre providers or developers.
  • Familiarity with land use, zoning, and entitlement processes, and the ability to identify regulatory risks that may affect feasibility or schedule.
  • Experience with or exposure to data centre design standards, including cooling strategies, power distribution, redundancy concepts, and scalability.
  • Ability to turn complex technical information into clear written assessments and concise go/no-go recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently during early assessments and exercise sound engineering judgment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with experience engaging landlords, utilities, developers, and real estate teams.
  • Excellent communication, technical writing, and presentation skills, including briefing leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • High comfort operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where rapid technical vetting and decision support are essential.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively to prospective data centre locations across EMEA and APAC.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Important: For this position, it is essential that you have a good command of the Dutch language, both written and spoken.

WPP Media

WPP Media is het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

  • We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.
  • We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.
  • We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Binnen WPP Media zijn wij het creatie team dat digitale campagnes nét dat beetje extra geeft. We mixen media, creativiteit en technologie om ideeën te maken die opvallen, raken en blijven hangen. Geen standaard banners of vluchtige clicks, maar slimme, opvallende en vaak verrassende creaties die écht aandacht trekken. Van interactieve formats tot dynamische campagnes: we zorgen dat merken niet alleen zichtbaar zijn, maar ook een glimlach, klik of wow-moment verdienen. Kortom – wij maken digitale media leuker, slimmer en effectiever.

Senior Project Manager
Bij ons draait alles om creatieve impact. En om dat vlekkeloos te laten verlopen, zoeken we een Senior Project Manager die energie krijgt van regelen, structureren én inspireren. Iemand die het creatieve proces strak organiseert, maar ook snapt dat de mooiste ideeën juist ontstaan als er ruimte is om te spelen.

Als Senior Project Manager Creative ben jij de spil tussen klant, jouw eigen creatie team en mediaspecialisten. Voor jouw klanten ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt: je denkt mee, geeft advies en zorgt dat ideeën werkelijkheid worden.

Wat ga je concreet doen?

  • Je organiseert en bewaakt het projectplan van A tot Z, inclusief scope, deadlines en deliverables.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere projectstructuren en planning voor alle disciplines.
  • Je bent hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten, interne teams en externe partners.
  • Je vertaalt creatieve en commerciële briefing naar uitvoerbare plannen en bewaakt verwachtingen.
  • Je identificeert risico’s vroegtijdig en zorgt dat issues worden opgelost voordat ze impact hebben.
  • Je bewaakt scopes, kwaliteitscriteria en KPI’s, en rapporteert hierover.
  • Je draagt bij aan verbeterde workflows, tools en werkwijzen zodat het team nog efficiënter werkt.
  • Je fungeert als brug tussen creatie, media en operations.

Wie ben jij?

  • Sterke projectmanager met min. 5+ jaar ervaring in rollen die draaien om planning, coördinatie, organisatie en procesoptimalisatie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het managen van complexe projecten (in agencies, techteams, productteams of andere uitvoerende omgevingen).
  • Je bent een pro in overzicht houden, risico’s inschatten en structureel werken — en je weet dit zelfverzekerd te vertalen naar teams en klanten.
  • Je hebt geen creatieve productie-achtergrond nodig (zoals design of copywriting); wat telt is jouw vermogen om projecten tot een goed einde te brengen.
  • Voorkeur voor ervaring met middelenbegrotingen, resource-planning en KPI-gestuurde workflows.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Salaris: €3000 – 4250 bruto per maand (op basis van 38,75 uur per week) afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.
  • Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).
  • Vrijheid: Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.
  • Werkomgeving: werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.
  • Klanten: Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.
  • Groeikansen: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.
  • Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.
  • 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).
  • Hybrid Working allowance: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.
  • Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.
  • Lunchfaciliteiten: Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.
  • Zorgverzekering: Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering.

Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.

Enthousiast? Laat van je horen en vertel ons waarom jij de Project Manager Creative bent die wij zoeken. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

⭐ About the role :

At DataDome, security is a core part of how we build and scale. Our security team already covers GRC, SecOps, and security leadership, and we are now looking for a senior individual contributor to strengthen the engineering-facing side of the function.

As DataDome evolves from a single product into a broader platform, our security scope is expanding across product, infrastructure, internal systems, and AI-enabled workflows. At the same time, our regulatory and assurance requirements are becoming more demanding, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with a strong technical background, able to work closely with engineering teams and bring practical security expertise to product security, cloud security, application security, secure software supply chain, security tooling, and AI security topics.

This role reports directly to the Head of Security. It is a pure individual contributor position with no management responsibilities. Impact comes from technical depth, hands-on execution, and cross-functional influence.

👉 You will be more specifically in charge of things like...

Product, cloud, and application security

  • Contribute to architecture, design, and implementation reviews for new features, services, platform changes, and cloud initiatives.
  • Support pragmatic threat modeling and secure-by-design practices across APIs, services, data flows, workloads, and platform components.
  • Advise engineering teams on application security, cloud and infrastructure security, and secure software supply chain topics.
  • Help teams make sound security trade-offs and support remediation on complex or high-priority topics.

AI security and enablement

  • Contribute to the security of AI-related product capabilities, including model, pipeline, data flow, and integration considerations.
  • Assess technical security risks related to internal AI usage, including data exposure, acceptable use, and vendor-related concerns, in partnership with the GRC function where relevant.
  • Identify practical opportunities to leverage AI in security workflows, including threat analysis, remediation support, security reviews, and compliance-related automation.

Technical risk and security enablement

  • Bring strong technical depth to security and risk discussions by helping identify realistic attack paths, assess practical impact and likelihood, and translate findings into pragmatic remediation priorities.
  • Partner with the GRC function to ensure risk assessments are supported by strong technical input and connected to concrete engineering actions.
  • Explain risks, trade-offs, and recommendations in a way that drives action across engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Make secure practices easier to adopt through clear guidance, repeatable patterns, automation, and pragmatic support.

Security tooling improvement

  • Contribute to improving and evolving our security tooling, in close collaboration with SecOps, with a focus on making security signals, posture insights, and remediation workflows more useful for Security and Engineering teams.
  • Develop use cases, dashboards, workflows, and integrations that help teams better understand, prioritize, and remediate security issues.

👤 It would be great if...

You bring a strong technical security foundation (+7 years) across application security, cloud and infrastructure security, and secure software supply chain.

You have worked in a SaaS or internet-scale product environment where security had to move at engineering speed.

You are comfortable working close to engineering teams: reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, supporting remediation, and turning security needs into practical improvements.

You enjoy going deep into security tools and using them to improve visibility, prioritization, remediation, and engineering workflows.

You bring hands-on security expertise to identify meaningful risks, evaluate practical impact, and guide pragmatic remediation priorities.

You are comfortable stepping in on urgent or high-impact security topics when needed, including incidents, emerging threats, complex remediations, and fast-moving cross-functional issues.

You thrive in a small team setup — where you own a broad scope, move fast without heavy process, and adapt when priorities shift.

French and English proficiency (working language is English, remote-friendly with occasional presence in Paris).

Bonus Points

  • Experience with SOC 2 Type II and third-party risk management in a SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with AI governance topics or security implications of AI tooling.

What’s in it for you?

  • Flex Life: While we offer remote, hybrid, & in-office options each position specifies the level of flexibility. Our Parisian office is located next to the Opera Garnier. You will also receive a 500€ stipend to help you set up your ideal workspace if you work hybrid or remotely.
    • If you are full remote, the SNCF dicount card is paid for you to come to our office to visit us & your team!
  • Generous Health Benefits: We have partnered with Kenko for your healthcare needs.
  • A 100€ annual allowance is provided for a leisure activity of your choice in Sports or Culture.
  • Annual allowance of €200 if you come to the office by bike to cover maintenance costs.
  • Professional Development: #Weaimhigh is part of our DNA, therefore we have invested in an internal Learning and Development platform and offer the opportunity to request additional training and support via your manager.
  • Events & Team building: #We care and we have fun! We organise ****Annual Company-Offsite, Events, Drinks, Winter Party, Lunch & Learns and much more are part of our Culture
  • Parent Care: Gift & care packages for parents.
  • PTO: Based on the country you are based from (e.g. 25 days in France).

What are the next steps?

  • You x Talent Acquisition Manager : first interview and cultural fit
  • You x Engineering Manager Damien : technical and cultural fit + Take-home technical challenge
  • You x Team: Presentation and review of your "technical proposal" with the team
  • You x Member of the leadership team - Discussion about DataDome vision and "raison d'être"!
  • Now you really met everyone! Welcome to DataDome :)

DataDome stops cyberfraud and bots in real time, outpacing AI-driven fraud from simple to sophisticated across your sites, apps, and APIs. Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Bot Management, the DataDome platform is built on a multi-layered AI engine that focuses on intent, not just identity. Because it’s not about knowing who’s real, it’s about what they intend to do. With thousands of AI models that adapt to every fraudulent click, signup, and login, DataDome blocks fraud in less than 2 milliseconds, without compromising performance. DataDome is fully automated and integrates seamlessly into any tech stack. Backed by a 24/7 SOC team of advanced threat researchers, DataDome stops over 350 billion attacks annually. Experience protection that outperforms with DataDome.

You'll design and build iwoca's new ledger platform – the distributed system that records every movement of money, starting with the business credit card and moving on to loans. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Ledger Platform team is rebuilding all of iwoca’s ledgers as one platform, starting with the ledger for the business credit card. Every card payment, loan repayment, and payout will end up there. Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets rely on that record, so it has to be right every time. The team is small – a principal engineer who leads it, another staff engineer, another engineer, and you. It works closely with the product teams that build on its ledgers, and with Finance. The role You'll lead projects from design to production, and decide with product what the team builds and how. With the principal engineer, you’ll set the platform’s technical direction, from service boundaries to the APIs and event streams other teams build on. Most of the platform is still to be built, and you’ll own part of it yourself. It’s a hands-on individual contributor role with high ownership and no line management. Every payment a small business makes with iwoca crosses several services and network hops before it reaches the ledger, and any of them can fail. You'll build services that record each one exactly once, with no single point of failure, safe timeouts and retries, and graceful degradation when a dependency is down. When something breaks in production, you'll fix it so it doesn't break again. You’ll learn iwoca’s financial products in depth, so you can challenge requirements and explain technical trade-offs to Finance. When the answer isn’t obvious, you’ll scope and prototype, and use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem. You’ll influence which parts of a problem need solving now, which can wait, and which aren’t worth solving at all. Live project examples: New ledgers. Building the ledgers for Flexi-Loan and iwocaPay. Account migration. Moving existing loan accounts onto the new ledgers with zero downtime and no data lost. Credit card ledger. Building new features for the credit card ledger, from real-time card holds to daily interest and monthly statements. Reconciliation and journals. Reconciling the ledger with banks, payment providers, and the card scheme, and producing the accounting journals Finance relies on. Funding facilities. Recording how loans move between iwoca’s funding facilities. The requirements Essential: Distributed systems. You’ve built and run fault-tolerant services in production, and handled the hard parts: durable communication between services, idempotency, transactional correctness, and partial failure. Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it. Databases. You’ve worked in depth with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, and solved data integrity, concurrency, and performance problems in them. Ownership. You’ve led large projects across several engineers or teams, end to end, and helped other engineers grow through design and code reviews. Testing. You’ve tested for edge cases and failures as carefully as you designed for them. AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: Financial systems. You’ve built ledgers, billing, or payment systems, including the audit trails and reconciliation that prove they’re correct. High volume. You’ve worked at a company where the volume of data or transactions shaped how you designed systems. Migrations. You’ve moved live systems and data onto a new platform with zero downtime. Python. You’ve used Python in production, with a web framework such as Django, FastAPI, or Flask. It’s the language the team works in. Data tooling. You’ve built pipelines with Snowflake and dbt, or similar, that turn ledger data into reports for Finance. Messaging. You’ve built asynchronous messaging with queues or topics, such as Kafka. The salary We expect to pay from £110,000 to £140,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. Electra is actively recruiting a Staff Electrical Engineer to help lead the design and development of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems for our 9-passenger eSTOL (electric short takeoff and landing), hybrid-electric aircraft. This position focuses on design, prototyping, integration, and testing, and is based in Olten, Switzerland.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design, analysis, integration, and testing of assigned electrical systems for our hybrid-electric aircraft.   • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, aerospace, or a related field; and

  • Master's or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with high-power hybrid-electric and/or fully electric propulsion systems and power electronics.
  • Working knowledge of the Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs), certification procedures (especially Part 23), and relevant industry standards.

Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Qui sommes-nous:

Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram.

Ton rôle au sein de l'équipe (Missions) :

Tu rejoindras notre équipe "Brand & Lifestyle", composée d'une dizaine de consultant.es passionné.es, et tu participeras activement à la mise en œuvre de programmes de communication impactants.

Sous la responsabilité de consultants expérimentés, tu seras un membre clé de nos équipes projets, avec des missions variées et formatrices :

  • Veille stratégique : Réaliser des veilles médiatiques et des recherches thématiques pour anticiper les tendances.
  • Rédaction impactante : Rédiger des communiqués de presse, des invitations médias, des notes de synthèse et des profils de journalistes.
  • Relations médias et influenceurs : Développer et entretenir des liens privilégiés avec les journalistes et les influenceurs.
  • Organisation et suivi : Participer à l'organisation d'interviews, assurer les relances journalistes et réaliser les bilans des événements médias.
  • Contribution stratégique : Collaborer à la conception de stratégies de communication innovantes (positionnement, messages clés, actions).
  • Soutien événementiel : Apporter ton aide à l'organisation d'événements.
  • Reporting d'activité : Contribuer à l'élaboration des rapports d'activité.

Ces missions sont conçues pour te faire monter en compétences et pourront évoluer au fil de ton stage.

 

Le profil que nous recherchons : Tu es en M1, M2 ou année de césure en communication, et tu as idéalement une première expérience en stage dans le domaine de la communication ou des Relations Publics. Une convention de stage est obligatoire.

Au-delà de ton parcours, nous apprécierons particulièrement :

  • Ton engagement : Impliqué.e, curieux.se, rigoureux.se et autonome, tu as également un fort esprit d'équipe.
  • Ton intérêt pour l'actualité : Tu es passionné.e par les médias et l'actualité.
  • Tes compétences en RP : Tu as une bonne connaissance des techniques de relations presse (relances, rédaction de communiqués de presse, shopping médias).
  • Ta qualité rédactionnelle : Tu as une excellente plume.
  • Tes qualités relationnelles : Tu es à l'aise dans les échanges et sais créer du lien.
  • Ton niveau d'anglais : L'anglais lu, écrit et parlé est un atout précieux, car certaines missions peuvent être internationales.

Nous valorisons la diversité des profils pour construire une équipe riche et complémentaire. La qualité essentielle que nous recherchons est ton envie d'apprendre et de te professionnaliser.

 

Un encadrement de qualité pour ta réussite (Encadrement et Formation) : Chez Burson, tu seras pleinement intégré.e à l'équipe et participeras à toutes nos activités (réunions d'équipe, réunions agence, moments de convivialité...).

Notre objectif est clair : te fournir une expérience professionnalisante et concrète pour renforcer ton employabilité à l'issue de ton stage. Nous sommes là pour t'accompagner et te faire progresser.

 

Tes avantages chez Burson (Rémunération et Autres Avantages) : Nous nous engageons à offrir un cadre de stage stimulant et avantageux :

  • Gratification : 750€/mois.
  • Flexibilité : Possibilité de télétravailler jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (jours flexibles en accord avec le manager) avec une indemnité de télétravail (10€/mois).
  • Mobilité : Forfait mensuel de 45,40€ pour tes transports (carte Swile).
  • Restauration : Prise en charge des repas au restaurant d’entreprise pour un reste à charge de 3,70€ (entrée-plat-dessert).
  • Temps libre : 1 jour de RTT par mois.
  • Avantages CE : Accès aux offres de notre comité d'entreprise (places de cinéma à 5€, chèques cadeaux culture, remboursements sportifs…).
  • Prime de cooptation : Une prime de 150€ en chèques cadeaux multi-enseignes pour l'aide au recrutement de tes successeurs.

 

Prêt.e à relever ce défi et à développer tes compétences en Relations Publics Consumer ?

Pour postuler : Envoie-nous ton CV et une lettre de motivation ou quelques lignes expliquant ton intérêt pour ce stage. Nous avons hâte de découvrir ton profil ! 👇
